title: unshorten livenet links file
description: The -livenet.links file of unshorten's live suite (livenet_test.go). It lives outside every git work tree and is never committed: a short link's token can identify the account that shared it. links.example.json is the committed example; it holds placeholder tokens only. The suite also enforces what JSON Schema cannot say here: case names are unique per host; an expected failure has no hops; entry "" means no request.

comment.description: Free text for the maintainer; ignored.

case.description: The case name. Record mode writes the drafts of the link's requests as drafts/<request host>/<case>.txtar, the fixture names under testdata/responses/.

url.description: The link as a user would post it: absolute http(s), no userinfo. A live run refuses the placeholder TOKEN.

kind.description: good: a link that resolves to its destination. invalid: an unknown code, which exercises the shortener's fallback or error path.

origin.description: created: a link the maintainer made from their own account. public: a link someone else made, already public; it is checked but never recorded, and its entry's committed positive fixture is synthetic (labelled so). synthetic: an invented code, safe to commit; kind must be invalid.

generic.description: Config.Generic for this link. Default PreviewOnly.

keep_destination.description: Keep the destination's host and path in the drafts. Set it only when the destination is the maintainer's own target; otherwise the drafts move it to example.net with its path shape kept. Query values that look like tokens are replaced either way.

note.description: What the case confirms, for the maintainer. Never written to the results or the drafts.

entry.description: The entry Resolver.Match reports, offline. "" when the link must not match: then failure is none, strategy "", status 0, and no request may be made.

failure.description: The resolution's outcome, from the sentinels the returned error wraps: none (no error), a FailureKind name, or not_short_link (an Intermediate entry stopped and the resolution failed open). transient is never expected: a transient outcome fails the case.

strategy.description: The Strategy name of the case's last request (RequestInfo.Strategy); "" when no request is made.

status.description: The HTTP status of the case's last request (RequestInfo.Status, the real status even for body strategies); 0 when no request is made or no response arrived.

host.description: The host of the final URL (Result.URL). Required when failure is none and entry is not "".

path.description: A Go regexp the final URL's escaped path must match; anchor it. Required when failure is none and entry is not "".

hops.description: When given, Result.Hops must be exactly these (entry, strategy, status). Only with failure none: a failed resolution reports no hops.

status.description: Hop.Status: 0 for body and preview strategies.
